**Description**

SONiC fanout startup-config template file [ansible/roles/fanout/templates/sonic_deploy.j2](https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/blob/master/ansible/roles/fanout/templates/sonic_deploy.j2) seems useless. I didn't find any codes in the repo using this file.

Currently, deploy SONiC fanout is using following templates:

* For SONiC 202012 fanout: [ansible/roles/fanout/templates/sonic_deploy_202012.j2](https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/blob/master/ansible/roles/fanout/templates/sonic_deploy_202012.j2)
* For SONiC 202205 fanout: [ansible/roles/fanout/templates/sonic_deploy_202205.j2](https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/blob/master/ansible/roles/fanout/templates/sonic_deploy_202205.j2)
